name: minecraft-pack-dev
description: 通用材质包修复技能与工具 for DeepSeek Harness：5 个按需加载技能（pack-core / pack-models / pack-textures / pack-lang / pack-cit）覆盖 MC 1.7.10 ~ 26.x 全时代资源包知识（pack_format 矩阵、CIT/citresewn、物品/方块/实体模型、纹理/GUI/字体、语言文件、音频、分版与分发），3 个工具（mc_pack_scaffold / mc_pack_validate / mc_pack_build）提供资源包项目骨架、全域规则校验（含 latest.log 日志诊断与 analyze 统计）与分版本 zip 组装

permissions.filesystem: mc_pack_scaffold writes only under the user-specified targetDir; mc_pack_validate reads only the user-specified packDir; mc_pack_build reads packDir and writes only under the user-specified outDir
